entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need to return something. I think. I have my order number if that helps. I'm a bit lost with your website.
Of course, I can certainly help you with that. Can you please provide me with the order number?
Okay, it's VF-8675309. It's for the cycling shoes I bought a while back.

Thank you. I'm pulling that up now... I see the VeloFit Pro-Lite cycling shoes, delivered on November 20th. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, um, I don't know if it's 'technical'. They just... they hurt my feet so much. I keep getting terrible blisters, even on short rides. I tried adjusting the cleats every which way, but nothing helps. The website made them look so comfortable.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Comfort is key for a good ride. Let me just check the return eligibility for you.
It's been a couple of months, I hope it's okay. I'm just so overwhelmed with all the different policies. Can't you just help me? I just want to send them back.

Of course. Please don't worry. I can see here that you are a VIP member with us, and we appreciate your loyalty. Let me see... yes, you are well within our 90-day return window for standard items. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. Thank you. So what do I do now?

It's my pleasure to help. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account right now. And as a valued VIP customer, I've also waived the return shipping fee and added a $15 store credit to your account for the trouble you've had. You can use that on your next order.
Wow, I... thank you so much, Sarah. That's really kind. I was so worried. You've made this so easy.

You're very welcome. Once we receive the cycling shoes at our warehouse, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
